# Human Reference Atlas urinary system models

This project uses the male left and right kidneys, ureters and urinary bladder
from the NIH Human Reference Atlas (HRA) 3D Reference Object Library.

## Sources

- `VH_M_Kidney_L.glb`: [Kidney, Male, Left (3DPX-021001)](https://3d.nih.gov/entries/21001/1)
- `VH_M_Kidney_R.glb`: [Kidney, Male, Right (3DPX-021002)](https://3d.nih.gov/entries/21002?version=1)
- `VH_M_Ureter_L.glb`: [Ureter, Male, Left (3DPX-021023)](https://3d.nih.gov/entries/3DPX-021023)
- `VH_M_Ureter_R.glb`: [Ureter, Male, Right (3DPX-021024)](https://3d.nih.gov/entries/3DPX-021024?version=1.01)
- `VH_M_Urinary_Bladder.glb`: [Urinary Bladder, Male (3DPX-021025)](https://3d.nih.gov/entries/21025?version=1.02)
- Reference library: [Human Reference Atlas 3D Reference Object Library](https://humanatlas.io/3d-reference-library)

Downloaded from NIH 3D on 2026-08-18.

## License and attribution

The HRA 3D reference objects are licensed under the
[Creative Commons Attribution 4.0 International license](https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/).

Attribution:

> Human Reference Atlas 3D Reference Object Library, HuBMAP Consortium.
> Visible Human Male reference kidneys. CC BY 4.0.

These assets are reference anatomy for an academic/educational prototype. They
are not patient-specific reconstructions and must not be used for clinical care.

starts at the HRA bladder neck and does not represent a procedural tube as real anatomy.
